name: Lechtal Camping Vorderhornbach
beschreibung: The Lechtal Camping Vorderhornbach campsite is peacefully nestled in the village of Vorderhornbach in the heart of the Tiroler Lech Nature Park. Bordered by the pristine gravel banks of the wild River Lech and the soaring peaks of the Lechtal Alps, it is an idyllic base for outdoor enthusiasts. The facility features spacious pitches with electrical connections for motorhomes and caravans, alongside green meadow plots for camping tents. Guests enjoy modern heated sanitary facilities, morning fresh bread delivery, and a children’s playground. Famous stages of the Lechweg long-distance trail and scenic mountain biking paths begin right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Nature-oriented campsite in Vorderhornbach in the Tiroler Lech Nature Park with modern amenities.
